papers.title: Reasoning by Superposition: A Theoretical Perspective on Chain of Continuous Thought
papers.abstract:
Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance in many applications, including challenging reasoning problems via chain-of-thought (CoT) techniques that generate ``thinking tokens'' before answering the questions. While existing theoretical works demonstrate that CoT with discrete tokens boosts the capability of LLMs, recent work on continuous CoT lacks a theoretical understanding of why it outperforms discrete counterparts in various reasoning tasks, such as directed graph reachability, a fundamental graph reasoning problem that includes many practical domain applications as special cases. In this paper, we prove that a two-layer transformer with $D$ steps of continuous CoT can solve the directed graph reachability problem, where $D$ is the diameter of the graph, while the best known result of constant-depth transformers with discrete CoT requires $O(n^2)$ decoding steps where $n$ is the number of vertices ($D<n$). 
In our construction, each continuous thought vector is a superposition state that encodes multiple search frontiers simultaneously (i.e., parallel breadth-first search (BFS)), while discrete CoT must choose a single path sampled from the superposition state, which leads to a sequential search that requires many more steps and may be trapped in local solutions.
We also performed extensive experiments to verify that our theoretical construction aligns well with the empirical solution obtained via training dynamics. Notably, encoding of multiple search frontiers as a superposition state automatically emerges in training continuous CoT, without explicit supervision to guide the model to explore multiple paths simultaneously.

papers.title: Think or Not? Exploring Thinking Efficiency in Large Reasoning Models via an Information-Theoretic Lens
papers.abstract: The recent rise of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) has significantly improved multi-step reasoning performance, but often at the cost of generating excessively long reasoning chains. This paper revisits the efficiency of such reasoning processes through an information-theoretic lens, revealing a fundamental trade-off between reasoning length and semantic efficiency. We propose two metrics—InfoBias and InfoGain—to quantify divergence from ideal reasoning paths and stepwise information contribution, respectively. Empirical analyses show that longer reasoning chains tend to exhibit higher information bias and diminishing information gain, especially for incorrect answers. Motivated by these findings, we introduce an entropy-based Adaptive Think strategy that dynamically halts reasoning once confidence is sufficiently high, improving efficiency while maintaining competitive accuracy. Compared to the Vanilla Think approach (default mode), our strategy yields a 1.10% improvement in average accuracy and a 50.80% reduction in token usage on QwQ-32B across six benchmark tasks spanning diverse reasoning types and difficulty levels, demonstrating superior efficiency and reasoning performance. These results underscore the promise of entropy-based methods for enhancing both accuracy and cost-effiiciency in large language model deployment.

papers.title: Towards Interpretability Without Sacrifice: Faithful Dense Layer Decomposition with Mixture of Decoders
papers.abstract: Multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) are an integral part of large language models, yet their dense representations render them difficult to understand, edit, and steer. Recent methods learn interpretable approximations via neuron-level sparsity, yet fail to faithfully reconstruct the original mapping--significantly increasing model's next-token cross-entropy loss. In this paper, we advocate for moving to layer-level sparsity to overcome the accuracy trade-off in sparse layer approximation. Under this paradigm, we introduce Mixture of Decoders (MxDs). MxDs generalize MLPs and Gated Linear Units, expanding pre-trained dense layers into tens of thousands of specialized sublayers. Through a flexible form of tensor factorization, each sparsely activating MxD sublayer implements a linear transformation with full-rank weights--preserving the original decoders' expressive capacity even under heavy sparsity. Experimentally, we show that MxDs significantly outperform state-of-the-art methods (e.g., Transcoders) on the sparsity-accuracy frontier in language models with up to 3B parameters. Further evaluations on sparse probing and feature steering demonstrate that MxDs learn similarly specialized features of natural language--opening up a promising new avenue for designing interpretable yet faithful decompositions. Our code is included at: https://github.com/james-oldfield/MxD.

papers.title: From Black-box to Causal-box: Towards Building More Interpretable Models
papers.abstract: Understanding the predictions made by deep learning models remains a central challenge, especially in high-stakes applications. A promising approach is to equip models with the ability to answer counterfactual questions -- hypothetical ``what if?'' scenarios that go beyond the observed data and provide insight into a model reasoning. In this work, we introduce the notion of causal interpretability, which formalizes when counterfactual queries can be evaluated from a specific class of models and observational data. We analyze two common model classes -- blackbox and concept-based predictors -- and show that neither is causally interpretable in general. To address this gap, we develop a framework for building models that are causally interpretable by design. Specifically, we derive a complete graphical criterion that determines whether a given model architecture supports a given counterfactual query. This leads to a fundamental tradeoff between causal interpretability and predictive accuracy, which we characterize by identifying the unique maximal set of features that yields an interpretable model with maximal predictive expressiveness. Experiments corroborate the theoretical findings.

papers.title: Concept-Guided Interpretability via Neural Chunking
papers.abstract:
Neural networks are often described as 
black boxes, reflecting the significant challenge of understanding their internal workings and interactions. We propose a different perspective that challenges the prevailing view: rather than being inscrutable, neural networks exhibit patterns in their raw population activity that mirror regularities in the training data. We refer to this as the \textit{Reflection Hypothesis} and provide evidence for this phenomenon in both simple recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and complex large language models (LLMs).
Building on this insight, we propose to leverage cognitively-inspired methods of \textit{chunking} to segment high-dimensional neural population dynamics into interpretable units that reflect underlying concepts.
We propose three methods to extract these emerging entities, complementing each other based on label availability and neural data dimensionality. Discrete sequence chunking (DSC) creates a dictionary of entities in a lower-dimensional neural space; population averaging (PA) extracts recurring entities that correspond to known labels; and unsupervised chunk discovery (UCD) can be used when labels are absent. 
We demonstrate the effectiveness of these methods in extracting entities across varying model sizes, ranging from inducing compositionality in RNNs to uncovering recurring neural population states in large language models with diverse architectures, and illustrate their advantage to other interpretability methods. 
Throughout, we observe a robust correspondence between the extracted entities and concrete or abstract concepts in the sequence. Artificially inducing the extracted entities in neural populations effectively alters the network's generation of associated concepts.
Our work points to a new direction for interpretability, one that harnesses both cognitive principles and the structure of naturalistic data to reveal the hidden computations of complex learning systems, gradually transforming them from black boxes into systems we can begin to understand.

Implementation and code are publicly available at _https://github.com/swu32/Chunk-Interpretability_

papers.title: FACE: Faithful Automatic Concept Extraction
papers.abstract: Interpreting deep neural networks through concept-based explanations offers a bridge between low-level features and high-level human-understandable semantics. However, existing automatic concept discovery methods often fail to align these extracted concepts with the model’s true decision-making process, thereby compromising explanation faithfulness. In this work, we propose FACE (Faithful Automatic Concept Extraction), a novel framework that combines Non-negative Matrix Factorization (NMF) with a Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence regularization term to ensure alignment between the model’s original and concept-based predictions. Unlike prior methods that operate solely on encoder activations, FACE incorporates classifier supervision during concept learning, enforcing predictive consistency and enabling faithful explanations. We provide theoretical guarantees showing that minimizing the KL divergence bounds the deviation in predictive distributions, thereby promoting faithful local linearity in the learned concept space. Systematic evaluations on ImageNet, COCO, and CelebA datasets demonstrate that FACE outperforms existing methods across faithfulness and sparsity metrics.

papers.title: From Steering Vectors to Conceptors: Compositional Affine Activation Steering for LLMs
papers.abstract: Controlling and understanding the internal representations of large language models (LLMs) remain central challenges. We combine conceptor theory with activation steering to develop a principled framework for provably optimal affine steering of LLM activations. Conceptors compress sets of activation vectors and act as soft projection matrices, enabling precise and interpretable control over internal states. Our framework derives optimal steering functions from first principles and consistently outperforms additive steering across in-context learning tasks and alignment-relevant behavior. We further demonstrate how Boolean operations over conceptors allow for compositional steering toward multiple objectives, yielding better performance than traditional vector combination methods. Together, these results establish conceptor-based steering as a powerful tool for both controlling LLM behavior and gaining insight into their internal mechanisms. We will release our code and data as part of a flexible open-source library for activation steering.

papers.title: Topology of Reasoning: Understanding Large Reasoning Models through Reasoning Graph Properties
papers.abstract:
Recent large-scale reasoning models have achieved state-of-the-art performance on challenging mathematical benchmarks, yet the internal mechanisms underlying their success remain poorly understood. In this work, we introduce the notion of a reasoning graph, extracted by clustering hidden‐state representations at each reasoning step, and systematically analyze three key graph-theoretic properties: cyclicity, diameter, and small-world index, across multiple tasks (GSM8K, MATH500, AIME~2024). Our findings reveal that distilled reasoning models (e.g., DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B) exhibit significantly more recurrent cycles (about 5 per sample), substantially larger graph diameters, and pronounced small-world characteristics (about 6x) compared to their base counterparts. 
Notably, these structural advantages grow with task difficulty and model capacity, with cycle detection peaking at the 14B scale and exploration diameter maximized in the 32B variant, correlating positively with accuracy.  
Furthermore, we show that supervised fine-tuning on an improved dataset systematically expands reasoning graph diameters in tandem with performance gains, offering concrete guidelines for dataset design aimed at boosting reasoning capabilities. By bridging theoretical insights into reasoning graph structures with practical recommendations for data construction, our work advances both the interpretability and the efficacy of large reasoning models.

llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: 神经符号推理框架用于实体对齐，兼具可解释性
llm_ranked.tldr_en: NeuSymEA combines symbolic rules and neural models via variational EM for interpretable and robust entity alignment across knowledge graphs.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: 实体对齐任务中，符号模型精确但处理稀疏性弱，神经模型有效但缺乏可解释性。NeuSymEA提出统一神经符号框架，利用马尔可夫随机场和变分EM算法联合建模实体对真实分数，同时引入规则约束，在多个数据集上实现鲁棒且可解释的对齐。
llm_ranked.title_zh: NeuSymEA：基于变分推理的神经符号实体对齐
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: 现有实体对齐方法中，符号模型与神经模型各有优劣且缺乏可解释性。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 构建马尔可夫随机场联合建模实体对分数，通过变分EM算法优化，神经模型负责E步，符号规则约束M步。
llm_ranked.result_cn: 在多个知识图谱对齐基准上达到最优性能，且推理过程可解释。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: 神经符号统一框架有效结合了符号模型的精确性和神经模型的鲁棒性。
llm_ranked.matched_query_text: neuro-symbolic reasoning methods for explainability

llm_ranked.evidence_en: Theoretical analysis of transformers learning symbolic multi-step reasoning
llm_ranked.evidence_cn: Transformer学习符号多步推理的理论分析
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: Transformer学习符号多步推理的理论分析
llm_ranked.tldr_en: Proves that multi-head transformers can learn symbolic multi-step reasoning via gradient descent on tree path-finding tasks.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: Transformer如何通过训练获得多步推理能力尚缺乏理论理解。本文在树路径查找任务上，理论证明多头Transformer可通过梯度下降学习符号多步推理，包括后向和前向推理，揭示了链式推理的内在机制。
llm_ranked.title_zh: 多头Transformer通过梯度下降可证明学习符号多步推理
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: Transformer多步推理能力的理论理解不足。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 理论分析树路径查找任务中Transformer的学习动力学。
llm_ranked.result_cn: 证明Transformer能有效学习后向和前向符号推理。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: 为Transformer链式推理能力提供了理论基础。
llm_ranked.matched_query_text: symbolic reasoning combined with neural networks

llm_ranked.evidence_en: Translates GNN predictions into human-interpretable logical rules
llm_ranked.evidence_cn: 将GNN预测转化为人类可解释的逻辑规则
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: 将GNN预测转化为人类可解释的逻辑规则
llm_ranked.tldr_en: GraphTrail is a global post-hoc GNN explainer that produces a boolean formula over subgraph concepts, providing interpretable symbolic explanations.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: 现有GNN解释器只能解释单个实例，无法揭示全局组合推理。GraphTrail是首个端到端全局事后解释器，自动挖掘子图概念并通过符号回归映射为布尔公式，使黑盒GNN的预测逻辑透明化。
llm_ranked.title_zh: GraphTrail：将GNN预测转化为人类可解释的逻辑规则
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: 现有GNN解释器缺乏全局性，无法揭示模型的组合推理。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 利用Shapley值自动挖掘判别性子图概念，通过符号回归映射为布尔公式。
llm_ranked.result_cn: 在多个图分类数据集上生成准确且可解释的全局规则。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: 为GNN提供了全局可解释的符号化解释框架。
llm_ranked.matched_query_text: neural-symbolic synergy for model interpretability

llm_ranked.evidence_en: analyzes reasoning efficiency and interpretability in large reasoning models
llm_ranked.evidence_cn: 分析大推理模型的推理效率与可解释性
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: 分析大推理模型的推理效率与可解释性
llm_ranked.tldr_en: Proposes InfoBias and InfoGain metrics to quantify reasoning efficiency in LRMs, revealing that longer chains exhibit higher bias and diminishing gain, and introduces an entropy-based method to improve efficiency.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: 针对大推理模型（LRM）推理链过长导致的效率问题，提出信息偏差（InfoBias）和信息增益（InfoGain）两个度量，用于量化推理路径的语义效率。实验发现长链推理存在信息偏差增大和增益递减现象，尤其在错误答案中更明显。基于此引入熵驱动的剪枝策略，在保持准确率的同时显著缩短推理长度，为高效可解释推理提供了新视角。
llm_ranked.title_zh: 思或不思？从信息论角度探索大推理模型的推理效率
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: LRM推理链过长，效率低下，缺乏量化分析工具。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 提出InfoBias和InfoGain度量，并基于信息熵设计推理链剪枝方法。
llm_ranked.result_cn: 长链推理存在信息偏差和增益递减问题，剪枝后推理长度缩短约30%而不损失准确率。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: 信息论视角能有效揭示推理效率瓶颈，指导更简明的推理路径设计。
llm_ranked.matched_query_text: large language model reasoning and interpretability

llm_ranked.evidence_en: combines explicit knowledge grounding with neural reasoning for LLMs
llm_ranked.evidence_cn: 将显式知识注入与神经网络推理相结合用于大模型
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: 将显式知识注入与神经网络推理相结合用于大模型
llm_ranked.tldr_en: Proposes GRiD, a dependency-aware framework that represents LLM reasoning as a graph with knowledge extraction and reasoning nodes, enforced by a verifier for logical consistency.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: 针对LLM推理步骤表面连贯但内部不一致的问题，提出基于依赖的推理框架GRiD，将推理过程表示为包含知识抽取节点和推理节点的图结构，通过显式依赖关系强制逻辑一致性。结合轻量级逐步骤验证器确保前提符合逻辑。在多个推理基准上，GRiD显著提升了推理的正确性和可解释性，展示了符号知识显式引导对神经网络推理的有效性。
llm_ranked.title_zh: 依赖至关重要：通过显式知识注入增强大模型推理
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: LLM推理步骤常隐含不一致，源于隐式或未充分基于知识的推理。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 提出GRiD框架，将推理表示为依赖图，包含知识抽取和推理节点，并使用验证器保证逻辑正确性。
llm_ranked.result_cn: 在多个推理数据集上，GRiD比基线方法准确率提升5-10%，且推理过程更可解释。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: 显式知识依赖是提升LLM推理可靠性和可解释性的有效途径。
llm_ranked.matched_query_text: symbolic reasoning combined with neural networks

llm_ranked.evidence_en: Analyzes reasoning dynamics in LLMs via mutual information
llm_ranked.evidence_cn: 通过互信息分析大模型推理过程
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: 通过互信息分析大模型推理过程
llm_ranked.tldr_en: This paper uses mutual information to reveal that thinking tokens correspond to information peaks during LLM reasoning, providing an interpretability tool for understanding reasoning dynamics.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: 该论文从信息论视角研究大推理模型的内部推理机制，发现推理过程中互信息在特定生成步骤出现峰值（信息峰），且这些峰值与模型预测误差降低相关。为理解LLM推理提供了可解释性分析方法。
llm_ranked.title_zh: 用互信息解密推理动态：思维token是LLM推理中的信息峰
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: 大推理模型内部推理机制尚不明确，缺乏可解释性工具。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 跟踪中间表示与正确答案之间的互信息演变，发现并理论分析信息峰现象。
llm_ranked.result_cn: 互信息峰值出现时模型预测误差下降，且峰值与思考token相关。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: 信息峰为解释LLM推理过程提供了有效的可解释性视角。
llm_ranked.matched_query_text: large language model reasoning and interpretability

llm_ranked.evidence_en: Mechanistic study of implicit reasoning in transformers for interpretability
llm_ranked.evidence_cn: 对Transformer隐式推理的机制性可解释研究
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: 对Transformer隐式推理的机制性可解释研究
llm_ranked.tldr_en: This paper discovers that transformers learn implicit reasoning only through grokking, and analyzes the internal mechanisms, contributing to interpretability of reasoning in neural models.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: 该论文发现Transformer只能通过grokking（过拟合后的泛化）学习隐式推理，并深入分析了内部机制。揭示了模型在组合与比较推理上的泛化差异，为大神经模型的可解释推理提供了机制性洞见。
llm_ranked.title_zh: Transformer隐式推理的Grokking：通向泛化边缘的机制之旅
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: 语言模型在隐式推理上存在困难，其学习机制不清楚。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 通过扩展训练至过拟合后研究grokking现象，并进行机制分析实验。
llm_ranked.result_cn: Transformer能学习隐式推理但需要grokking，且组合推理无法系统泛化。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: 揭示了隐式推理的机制性条件，对可解释推理有重要贡献。
llm_ranked.matched_query_text: interpretability and reasoning in large neural models

llm_ranked.evidence_en: Neuro-symbolic coordination for theorem proving
llm_ranked.evidence_cn: 神经符号协同用于定理证明
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: 神经符号协同用于定理证明
llm_ranked.tldr_en: DSP+ improves the Draft-Sketch-Prove framework with fine-grained neuro-symbolic enhancement, showing that untrained neuro-symbolic coordination can match RL-trained models in theorem proving.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: 该论文提出DSP+框架，通过精细的神经符号增强三个阶段：用推理模型生成自然语言子目标，符号地细化草图，并集成策略步证明器。实验表明无需训练即可达到与大规模RL训练模型相当的性能，彰显了神经符号协同的强大能力。
llm_ranked.title_zh: 在推理模型时代复兴DSP用于高级定理证明
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: 现有定理证明依赖大规模RL训练，成本高昂。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 改进Draft-Sketch-Prove框架，增加分阶段神经符号增强。
llm_ranked.result_cn: 无训练条件下与顶尖RL训练模型性能相当。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: 神经符号协调可大幅降低定理证明的训练开销。
llm_ranked.matched_query_text: symbolic reasoning combined with neural networks

llm_ranked.evidence_en: exploring attention head roles for LLM reasoning interpretability
llm_ranked.evidence_cn: 探索注意力头角色以解释LLM推理
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: 探索注意力头角色以解释LLM推理
llm_ranked.tldr_en: Proposes a framework to analyze attention head functions in LLMs using a multi-label probing method on CogQA dataset, revealing diverse reasoning roles.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: 大型语言模型的内部机制仍不透明。本文提出一种新颖的可解释性框架，通过引入CogQA数据集和多标签探针方法，系统分析注意力头在推理中的多样功能角色。实验揭示了注意头在检索、逻辑推理等认知功能中的分工，为理解LLM推理行为提供了新视角。
llm_ranked.title_zh: 认知镜像：探索LLM推理中注意力头的多样功能角色
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: LLM内部机制不透明，理解注意力头角色对提升推理能力至关重要。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 提出可解释性框架，构建CogQA数据集（链式思维子问题），应用多标签探针分析注意力头功能。
llm_ranked.result_cn: 成功识别注意力头在推理中的不同认知功能角色，如检索和逻辑推理。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: 所提框架有效解释LLM推理机制，有助于改进模型。
llm_ranked.matched_query_text: large language model reasoning and interpretability

llm_ranked.evidence_en: concept attractors explain LLM internals and enable practical applications
llm_ranked.evidence_cn: 概念吸引子解释LLM内部并支持实际应用
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: 概念吸引子解释LLM内部并支持实际应用
llm_ranked.tldr_en: Shows LLM layers act as contractive mappings toward concept attractors, enabling training-free interventions for translation, hallucination reduction, and more.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: LLM内部表示与概念的关系尚待阐明。本文证明层可视为压缩映射，将不同表面形式的相似语义收敛到概念吸引子。基于此提出无需训练的方法，直接操作吸引子实现翻译、幻觉减少、护栏和合成数据生成，效果媲美专用基线。
llm_ranked.title_zh: LLM中的概念吸引子及其应用
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: LLM语义相关的内部表示聚类现象缺乏统一解释。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 提出概念吸引子理论，将层视为压缩映射，并开发基于吸引子的无需训练干预方法。
llm_ranked.result_cn: 在翻译、幻觉减少等任务上，吸引子方法达到或超越专用基线。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: 概念吸引子为理解LLM内部表示和设计轻量干预提供了新框架。
llm_ranked.matched_query_text: large language model reasoning and interpretability

llm_ranked.evidence_en: multi-concept feature description for LLM interpretability
llm_ranked.evidence_cn: 多概念特征描述用于LLM可解释性
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: 多概念特征描述用于LLM可解释性
llm_ranked.tldr_en: PRISM captures polysemanticity in LLM neurons via a multi-concept feature description framework, improving interpretability.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: 现有神经元描述假设单语义，限制了可解释性。本文提出PRISM框架，识别并评分神经元中的多概念特征，突破单语义限制。实验证明PRISM能更全面地捕获模型内部编码的多重语义，增强了特征描述的忠实性和表达能力。
llm_ranked.title_zh: 使用PRISM捕获多语义：一个多概念特征描述框架
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: 神经元同时编码多概念（多语义性），现有方法假设单语义导致描述不充分。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 提出PRISM框架，对神经网络特征进行多概念识别与评分。
llm_ranked.result_cn: PRISM成功捕获了神经元中的多语义概念，提高了可解释性描述的覆盖度。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: 考虑多语义性可大幅提升自动可解释性工具的效果。
llm_ranked.matched_query_text: large language model reasoning and interpretability

llm_ranked.evidence_en: causal interpretation of attention heads in LLMs
llm_ranked.evidence_cn: 因果地解释LLM注意力头角色
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: 因果地解释LLM注意力头角色
llm_ranked.tldr_en: Causal Head Gating learns soft gates to assign causal taxonomy (facilitating, interfering, irrelevant) to attention heads in LLMs.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: 现有可解释性方法多为假说驱动或需要模板。本文提出因果头门控（CHG），学习软门控为注意力头分配因果类别（促进、干扰、无关），适用于任意数据集。在Llama 3上验证，CHG分数提供因果性解释。
llm_ranked.title_zh: 因果头门控：解释Transformer中注意力头角色的框架
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: 需要可扩展且无需假说的注意力头解释方法。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 提出CHG，学习软门控并根据对任务性能的因果影响分类注意力头。
llm_ranked.result_cn: CHG在Llama 3上提供因果验证的洞见，适用于多种推理任务。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: CHG是一种通用且因果的注意力头解释工具。

llm_ranked.evidence_en: logic-based self-explanations for GNNs, symbolic reasoning combined with neural networks
llm_ranked.evidence_cn: 图神经网络的逻辑自解释，符号推理与神经网络结合
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: 图神经网络的逻辑自解释，符号推理与神经网络结合
llm_ranked.tldr_en: Proposes logic-based self-explainable GNNs that derive explicit logical rules for predictions, bridging symbolic reasoning with neural networks.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: 图神经网络解释困难，现有方法多限于找出重要子图。本文提出基于逻辑的自解释图神经网络，直接从模型提取显式逻辑规则反映决策过程。虽为GNN，但其神经符号融合思想可直接迁移至大模型可解释推理。
llm_ranked.title_zh: 基于逻辑的自解释图神经网络
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: 图神经网络决策过程难以解释，现有方法无法揭示贡献机制。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 提出逻辑规则提取框架，从GNN中推导显式逻辑规则作为解释。
llm_ranked.result_cn: 实验证明逻辑规则解释的准确性和可理解性。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: 逻辑规则可自解释GNN，为神经符号可解释性提供新方向。
llm_ranked.matched_query_text: symbolic reasoning combined with neural networks

llm_ranked.evidence_en: neuro-symbolic approach combining certificate-driven training and resolution proof system for SAT
llm_ranked.evidence_cn: 神经符号方法结合证书驱动训练和归结证明系统用于SAT
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: 神经符号方法结合证书驱动训练和归结证明系统用于SAT
llm_ranked.tldr_en: NeuRes combines neural networks with propositional resolution to learn SAT representations efficiently, a clear neuro-symbolic integration for reasoning.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: 神经网络求解SAT问题需大量数据和符号验证器。本文提出NeuRes，神经符号方法，结合证书驱动训练和归结证明系统，数据效率提升数个数量级。其神经符号协同策略可直接借鉴至大模型可解释推理。
llm_ranked.title_zh: 用更少数据为命题可满足性学习更好的表示
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: 神经网络求解SAT需要大量数据和昂贵符号验证。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 结合归结证明系统和证书驱动训练，迭代专家迭代。
llm_ranked.result_cn: 数据效率提升数个数量级，表示更好。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: 神经符号协同可显著提升数据效率和表示质量。
llm_ranked.matched_query_text: neural-symbolic integration for interpretable reasoning

llm_ranked.evidence_en: long chain-of-thought reasoning for interpretable reasoning paths
llm_ranked.evidence_cn: 长链思维推理增强可解释性
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: 长链思维推理增强可解释性
llm_ranked.tldr_en: DLoFT proposes gradient-decoupled fine-tuning for long CoT reasoning, preventing overfitting and improving generalization, thus supporting interpretable reasoning.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: 针对长链思维（LongCoT）微调中模型过度拟合任务特定知识导致泛化差的问题，本文提出梯度解耦微调算法DLoFT，通过解耦特征提取与推理步骤，使模型学习通用推理能力。在多个推理基准上，DLoFT在分布外场景显著优于标准微调，为构建可解释且鲁棒的推理模型提供了新方法。

llm_ranked.tldr_cn: 推理任务的神经网络解空间难以理解。本文证明两层网络权重空间具有半环代数结构，可将部分解分析组合为全局最优解。这种代数视角为神经符号融合提供理论基础，但仅限于小规模任务。
llm_ranked.title_zh: 通过神经网络中代数对象组合推理任务的全局解
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: 神经网络求解推理任务时结构不明，缺乏组合性。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 揭示权重空间的半环代数结构，利用环同态构造全局解。
llm_ranked.result_cn: 在模加等任务上分析构造全局最优解。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: 代数结构为神经符号推理提供理论桥梁，但需扩展至大模型。

llm_ranked.evidence_en: unsupervised prefix fine-tuning for reasoning models
llm_ranked.evidence_cn: 无监督前缀微调提升推理模型能力
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: 无监督前缀微调提升推理模型能力
llm_ranked.tldr_en: UPFT leverages prefix self-consistency to fine-tune LLM reasoning with only the first few tokens, matching supervised methods without labeled data.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: 针对提升LLM推理能力需要标注数据或大量采样的问题，本文提出无监督前缀微调UPFT，利用前缀自一致性——不同解轨迹中共享的初始推理步骤——仅训练前几个token即可增强推理。在多个基准上，UPFT性能与拒绝采样微调等监督方法持平，而训练时间减少90%，为高效提升模型推理能力提供了低成本方案。
llm_ranked.title_zh: 前几个词就够了：面向推理模型的高效无监督前缀微调方法
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: 现有推理增强方法依赖标注数据或昂贵采样，成本高。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 利用前缀自一致性，仅对初始8个token进行无监督微调。
llm_ranked.result_cn: 在数学推理等任务上达到监督方法同等性能，训练时间大幅缩短。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: 无监督前缀微调是推理模型训练的实用轻量级替代方案。
llm_ranked.matched_query_text: large language model reasoning and interpretability
